content.short: Squirrel Wallet is a non-custodial mobile wallet with social-recovery guardians across 100+ chains.
content.description: Squirrel Wallet replaces the seed phrase with a guardian-based recovery system, where trusted individuals can help restore access to a private key. It covers more than 109 chains and lets a user view and trade assets across them without switching networks. Fiat purchases are available in over 160 countries, and one-click DeFi reaches EVM protocols from the same interface. The wallet issues the NUTS token.
content.meta: Guardian-based recovery across 100+ chains, so a lost device is not a lost wallet.
